_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that facilitates global commerce and money movement across more than 200 countries and territories among a global set of consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities through innovative technologies.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (since the FY2020 10-K none carries the earlier sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; GENAI (live from 2022-11-30) is out of scope: its registered scope names no payments network, and the 10-K's competition words on it concern Visa's value-added services ('The integration of technology like generative AI can create new and better offerings that compete with our value added services, such as strengthened risk monitorization and managing digital identification.'), not the network; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa

theme_watch.reason: Live: Visa's own FY2023 10-K says 'The global payments industry is undergoing significant and rapid technological change, including increased proliferation of mobile and other proximity and in-app payment technologies, ecommerce, tokenization, cryptocurrencies, distributed ledger and blockchain technologies, cloud-based encryption and authorization, and new authentication technologies such as biometrics, FIDO 2.0, 3D Secure 2.0 and dynamic cardholder verification values or dCVV2.' The stock trades at 33.7x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of Visa's network specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that facilitates global commerce and money movement across more than 200 countries and territories among a global set of consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities through innovative technologies.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (since the FY2020 10-K none carries the earlier sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; GENAI (live from 2022-11-30) is out of scope: its registered scope names no payments network, and the 10-K's competition words on it concern Visa's value-added services ('The integration of technology like generative AI can create new and better offerings that compete with our value added services, such as strengthened risk monitorization and managing digital identification.'), not the network; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.40x; +47% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.36; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.1%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.7%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.5%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2024-09-06) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.40x (41.3% downside to Bear $163.91 / +29.6% upside to Bull $362.11) | Adj composite 1.52 vs market 2.88: gap -1.36 [OVERVALUED] | +47% above the EPP floor $190.44 (23x FY24E $8.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: +1.5% total (+0.7%/yr) | At 33.7x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $369.47 sits above the BULL case; revenue +9.6% YoY in Q3 FY24, forward revenues +9.6% (Q3 FY24 revenue growth (no FY24 revenue range)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
